notes.title: Update 2.0.1.0
notes.content: Modified the paddle's movement, making it faster and more responsive to the mouse.

notes.title: Update 2.0.0.0
notes.content: Redesigned the levels, adding more bricks and more hearts.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Added 3 difficulty options: Easy, Medium and Hard.
Dfficulty affects the ball's initial speed  when is launched and its speed increase when it bounces off a destructible brick.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1.0
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the ball can get stucked between two bricks; if this happens the ball will be sent back to its starting position on the paddle.

notes.title: Update notes (08-03-2021)
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0.0

[list]
[*] Added 12 Steam Achievements.
[*] The scores texts were moved to the edges of the screen, outside the playing area.
[*] A 16:9 (widescreen) aspect ratio was enforced at any resolution to be able to carry out the previous point.
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes (07-23-2021)
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.1.0

[list]
[*] Fixed the erratic bouncing when the ball hits a brick corner.
[*] If the ball goes into a horizontal or vertical motion, the game now takes less time to get it out of there.
[*] Changed the bounce of the ball on the paddle (before: only the paddle's rounded corners allowed to change the bounce angle. Now: the classic behavior, if the ball hits the left half of the paddle, it bounces to the left, and if it hits the right half, it bounces to the right; the angle depends on how far from the paddle's center the bounce occurs).
[*] Added the "Esc" key as an option to pause the game (in addition to the "P" key, the right mouse click and the "Start" button on the gamepad).
[*] Fixed an audio glitch that caused laser and lightning sounds to not play properly.
[/list]
